Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 2 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · retells · "Every pr and wait ends up being a point where a session gets forgotten and the work abandoned" (Four questions for any unit of work; we tune, we do not perfect (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "dogfood until we know work is not lost when it follows the defined process and any new agent knows how to find the process" (Dogfood until work is not lost; a stop for approval is a failure (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-28 · retells · "We need to have a holon of work clearly marked as in progress so that it gets driven to finish" (Drive the unit to delivery autonomously; predict the stops now; a paused question lives on the desk; the holon is marked in progress (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "Once we begin, we need to make sure that the whole unit is completed." (Claim the affirmation chain and complete the whole unit; solve principle-based decisions by principle (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "Marking it as an in progress unit" (Remember this process: create a holon, scan the chain, mark it in progress, settle decisions by principle, walk delivery, split if unsafe, pre-empt stops with one focused owner session (2026-10-28))
